description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01194424
Sheriff’s File # 26001368
PLAINTIFF – The Bank of New York Mellon, vs:
DEFENDANTS- Michael J. Scalzo et als.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 31st day of August, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Long Branch, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 12, Block 182 on the official Tax Map of the City of Long Branch.
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
430 Division Street Long Branch, NJ 07740
Dimensions: Approximately: 50X178
Upset Price: Approximately: $259,349.74 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Unknown
Nearest Cross Street: Exchange Place
BEGINNING AT A POINT THE SOUTHEASTERLY LINE OF DIVISION STREET SAID POINT BEING DISTANT 99.00 FEET SOUTHWESTERLY FROM THE INTERSECTION OF THE SAME AND THE SOUTHWESTERLY LINE OF EXCHANGE PLACE; THENCE (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 05/06/2026; 2026 Qtr. 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $1,992.00 BILLED; $1.74 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $1990.26 PAID 2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $1,992.00 OPEN; SUBJECT TO POSTING 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 08/01/2026 TO BE DETERMINED Sewer: Long Branch Sewer Auth Acct: 4443 0 04/01/2026-06/30/2026 $92.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY $184.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS Water: PRIVATE-NJ American Water Co. General Remark: 2026 TAXES WILL REFLECT CHANGE IN ASSESSED VALUE SUBJECT TO TAX SALE. SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL FEES. Information: New owner must obtain tax bill from Tax Office.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $258,126.16.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: July 7, 2026
Frenkel, Lambert, Weiss, Weisman & Gordon, LLP
53 Gibson Street
Bay Shore, NY 11706
212-344-3100
